C string parsing, formatting, tokenizing, hashing, and UTF-8 append helpers.

# Purpose
This header file declares utilities for working with `'\0'`-terminated character strings. It provides conversion functions from cstr values to numeric types, string hashing, case-insensitive compare, length checks, formatted output, tokenization, and helpers for building strings in place. It also includes inline append functions for text, integers, fixed-point values, and UTF-8 code points, plus wrappers such as `fd_isdigit` and `fd_isspace` that force `ctype.h` tests to return `0` or `1`. The file is a shared cstr support interface for parsing, formatting, and string handling across the code base.
